json_canonicalization: UTF-8, json.dumps indent=2, trailing newline; hashed artifacts are the committed bytes, not a second canonicalizer.
circularity_rule: A hashed artifact must not contain its own digest. A later artifact may cite an earlier digest only after that earlier file has been written. Receipts and this scheme file are hash destinations, not members of the cohorts/tasks digest.
c1_historical_cohorts_note: C-002-2 does not rewrite cohorts.json. The C1 digest remains the cohorts digest until C-002-3 updates MRF/expansion fields. Historical C1 receipts keep this digest even after C3.
